project_name: Kathleen Valley Lithium Project hybrid power station
location: Kathleen Valley, Northern Goldfields, Western Australia
selection_note: Hindsight-selected development case (not a sealed holdout), chosen because the entire sequence - PFS, DFS, competitive power tender, Letter of Award - is on ASX with exchange release timestamps. The power solution changed between PFS (grid tee-off plus 4.4 MW solar) and DFS (3rd-party on-site hybrid facility), so lead time depends on which earlier signal a reviewer accepts as 'power-relevant'.

anticipated site wide *online* power demand including underground is 13.5MW.

lead_time.note: CAUTION: the 703-day figure is measured from the PFS (ASX 09/10/2020), which assumed GRID power (132 kV tee-off) plus a 4.4 MW solar farm; it is NOT a signal of a third-party on-site power procurement. The first signal naming third-party on-site generation is the DFS (s4, ASX 11/11/2021), and DFS-to-Letter-of-Award is about 305 days. A reviewer should decide which is the legitimate earliest signal. ASX times were read from the ASX listing by the agent and not captured.

blockers: ASX release times were read from the ASX announcements listing (Sydney time) via curl; the listing page itself is not captured as evidence.

PFS power assumption (grid) differs from the eventual third-party on-site solution, so the PFS-to-target gap (about 703 days) overstates the lead time; the DFS-to-target gap (about 305 days) is the more relevant figure.
Buyer-side tender run-up (competitive tender timing, shortlisted bidders) not found in public sources.
Captures are PDF-to-markdown; quotes containing markdown artefacts (e.g. *online*) are verbatim from the capture, not the original PDF text.
reviewer_checklist: Open the ASX listing for LTR 2020/2021/2022 and confirm the three release timestamps and time zone convention.
Confirm the PFS grid-power assumption vs the DFS third-party assumption and decide which signal anchors lead time.
Confirm Zenith Energy is the awarded supplier and that this is the first procurement-level event (earlier tender not public).
Confirm the project is not already in the cohort and that hindsight selection is acceptable for a development case.
target_fit_note: Letter of Award to an IPP to finance, build, own and operate a 95 MW hybrid (wind/solar/battery/thermal) off-grid power station for an initial 15-year term: long-term on-site supply, not temporary or rental power. The release says it follows a competitive tender, so the tender stage pre-dates the target but is not public.
